content_sections.heading: About Amrita
content_sections.text: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham is a university whose programmes run from undergraduate to doctoral level. Its campuses include Amritapuri, Amaravati, Bengaluru, Chennai, Faridabad, Kochi, Mysuru, Coimbatore, Nagercoil and Haridwar. This vacancy is at the Chennai Campus.

faq.question: Q1. Which department is this Amrita faculty vacancy in?
faq.answer: The single vacancy is in the Department of Physics at the Chennai Campus.

faq.question: Q2. Is a PhD compulsory for this post?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice marks a PhD in Physics from a reputed institute as mandatory, along with more than First Class in academics throughout.

faq.question: Q3. Can I apply if I have not taught B.Tech or M.Tech students?
faq.answer: The notice lists experience of teaching B.Tech/M.Tech engineering students as preferred, not mandatory.

faq.question: Q4. What decides the Assistant Professor grade?
faq.answer: Experience and capability decide whether the role is at starting level, senior grade or selection grade.

faq.question: Q5. Is research experience needed?
faq.answer: Yes. The skills required include a proven research track record with quality publications.

faq.question: Q6. Does the post require knowledge of mathematics?
faq.answer: Yes. Although this is a Physics post, the notice asks for strong knowledge of core and applied mathematics in engineering.

faq.question: Q7. Who can I contact for more details?
faq.answer: The notice gives one contact for details: [email protected].
